title: NFL VP Mike North: We don't draft our way into primetime, we play our way into primetime

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: NFL VP Mike North: We don't draft our way into primetime, we play our way into primetime
sources.description: Though they drafted quarterback Fernando Mendoza at No. 1 overall in April, the Raiders are one of five teams without a scheduled primetime game in 2026.
